outcome: Delta EUM index (change in EUM index)
cohort: The study included women with singleton gestations at term (>= 37 + 0 weeks) who were undergoing labor augmentation with oxytocin.
finding: Uterine electrical activity (EUM index) significantly increased following oxytocin administration and correlated with baseline activity, but neither the delta EUM index nor the mean EUM index during oxytocin administration correlated with time to delivery.
